Stakeholders.title: To Our Stakeholders
Stakeholders.intro: Dear team members, users, and investors; on this page I will tell you about both talkinbio and how we work together.

q1.title: Why Now
q1.content:
For individual service providers running their business through social media, something changed in the last three years: DMs went from being a content channel to a sales channel. Booking appointments, asking about prices, negotiating, deciding. All of this flows through Instagram DMs. And sellers are no longer able to manage this volume.

The opening of WhatsApp Business API to individual accounts added a new layer: a seller can now technically access an infrastructure to operate all their channels from behind a single link, in a single voice. But there is no tool to set this up, manage it, and grow with it.

Linktree didn't see this gap. Salesforce didn't care about this segment. The CRM giants sold their packages to SMBs, not to individuals. This gap was left empty intentionally. We are building the solution inside it.

q2.title: What Happens If Nothing Changes
q2.content:
A customer asks a question. The reply comes 4 hours later. The customer already went somewhere else. The seller doesn't even notice.

This scenario plays out every day across tens of thousands of the 600,000 individual sellers in Turkey alone. The revenue loss is invisible because nobody says 'I missed them.' The customer left. It doesn't get counted.

For investors, let's make this concrete: A seller receives an average of 10 DMs per day. 40% of those come with buying intent. Due to response delays, 2 of those 4 customers are lost. Average transaction value: $20. That's $14,600 in annual losses for a single seller. Multiply across the market and the damage is incalculable.

For the team, a simpler truth: We are here to solve this problem. And if we can't, then what needs to stop, stops.

q3.title: Why Existing Alternatives Fall Short
q3.content:
Linktree: It doesn't answer the visitor's question. Someone clicking a seller's link wants to learn about a service, but there's no match. Linktree is a storefront, not a representative.

ManyChat and similar chatbot tools: Complex setup, fixed and brittle scenarios. Designing a separate flow for each question requires technical knowledge. Individual sellers don't have the time or capacity.

Large CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive): Overly complex for a coach or beauty professional. Onboarding takes weeks, pricing is annual subscription-based, integration requires technical knowledge. These products were designed for businesses with IT departments inside their walls.

WhatsApp Business alone: Questions come in, they reply manually. No automation, no follow-up, no analytics. Just slightly more organized messaging.

None of them combine 24/7 availability, question-answering, customer classification, lead list generation, and marketing recommendations in one place. That gap is talkinbio.

q4.title: What We Do
q4.content:
talkinbio consists of two components.

Saule is the 24/7 AI assistant on your bio page. A visitor asks a question, Saule listens, understands, and responds like a representative who knows your services. It collects appointments, records interested visitors, and flags follow-up situations. When you wake up in the morning, you don't find missed DMs — you find a sorted and labeled lead list.

Beiwe is the agent that analyzes these conversations and produces weekly marketing recommendations. 'Which question was asked most this week? Which service got the most interest? What hours saw the most visitors?' — Beiwe answers these questions and lets you base your next content decision on data.

Setup takes 10 minutes. No coding required. Once the system starts running, it works even when you don't.

q5.title: What Makes Us Different
q5.content:
At the bottom of every Saule conversation is a small signature: 'You're chatting with Saule — talkinbio.com.' This signature is seen by every user who visits the seller's page. The user thinks 'I want this for my page too' and signs up. That means the product grows itself. CAC stays organic without paid acquisition.

First advantage: The viral loop. Every active assistant becomes a channel for acquiring new users.

Second advantage: Accumulated conversation data. The more Beiwe is used, the more personalized it becomes. A new competitor cannot immediately copy this data advantage. Early users carry strategic value in terms of data richness.

Third: Turkish-first architecture. We're building the localization skeleton from the ground up — one that adapts to markets with different languages and payment infrastructures (MENA, LatAm). This means a v2 expansion that doesn't have to start from scratch.

q6.title: Our Revenue Model
q6.content:
We operate a credit-based subscription system. Three tiers.

Starter ($9/month, 200 credits): For the individual seller receiving 3–5 DMs per day, setting up an assistant for the first time. Users at this tier are learning what Saule is and testing the system's value.

Pro ($29/month, 700 credits): For sellers receiving 30+ DMs per week with a regular customer base who use Beiwe analytics. This tier is our core revenue engine.

Business ($79/month, 1,800 credits): For sellers managing multiple service lines, high-volume DM traffic, and mature automation needs.

Pricing is dollar-fixed. TL collection is at the current exchange rate. Annual payment comes with a 20% discount — savings for the customer and a buffer against currency risk for us.

Effective ARPU: $15 (early-stage Starter-heavy mix + annual discount effect). LTV: $300 (at 5% churn assumption). CAC target: below $100 — the viral signature loop should keep this organic.

q7.title: Where We're Headed
q7.content:
Today we're at Stage 1: Problem/Solution Fit. Our OMTM is number of paying customers. The counter is currently at 0/10. Goal: complete 20 problem interviews, validate the recurring pain points, launch the first 10 pilots at $9/month paid.

Stage 2 (550 customers, $100K ARR): Crossing this threshold is proof of Problem/Solution Fit. By then we'll have measured whether the viral loop works. The investor conversation starts from here.

Stage 3 (v2 Global, ~4,500 customers, $810K ARR base case): Direct WhatsApp and Instagram DM integration. MENA and LatAm localization. Language expansion. At this point Saule no longer only lives on the bio page — it works across every channel.

Stretch scenario (6% global capture): ~9,000 customers, ~$1.6M ARR.

Every step requires proof from the previous one. Right now we're doing what's next: the first 10 payments.

In the long run, talkinbio is not just a tool for individuals. Saule and Beiwe are evolving into an agent infrastructure that works across every communication channel for businesses. We're not naming this phase yet — the product will speak for itself.

q8.title: How We Work
q8.content:
We follow the Running Lean methodology. This isn't a slogan — it's a framework that directly determines how we work.

Problem validation before product. We complete customer interviews before building. If a recurring pain point doesn't emerge from 20 interviews, we increase the number.

No free trials. This isn't just a preference — it's a methodological decision. In Ash Maurya's Running Lean this is clear: free early access collects the curious, not customers. The first 10 to pay are the test of the value hypothesis — payment is commitment.

Continuous Improvement dashboard: Lean Canvas, Fermi Estimation, Traction Roadmap, and Lean Pitch — all of these, including the page you're reading now, are living documents. They update as we change, and every update is saved with a version. Version discipline is a standard.

Evidence classes are transparent. What's been validated is stated clearly. So is what hasn't. Inflated claims of proof are not accepted.

q9.title: What We're Asking For
q9.content:
To our users: Setup takes 10 minutes. Connect your bio link to talkinbio and see how many leads Saule collects in a month. If it creates no value, don't continue. If it does, you now know.

To our investors: We're currently in early-stage bootstrapped mode. The time for an investment conversation is when we cross $100K ARR. But rather than introducing ourselves only at that point, we wanted you to know us now. The numbers are real, the model is honest, the open questions are open. We'll be in touch when we're ready.

To our team: When you need to remember why building this matters, come back to this page. We believe what we're doing is right. That's the only thing left to prove.

Legal.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR Notice
Legal.copy: PEH Solutions takes the privacy and security of your personal data seriously. This page explains how we collect, use and protect your data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable privacy laws.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: PEH Solutions (referred to as 'Company', 'PEH', 'we' or 'us') is the data controller for personal data collected through the talkinbio platform. Contact: info@talkinbio.com

sections.title: 2. Personal Data We Collect
sections.body:
When you use the talkinbio platform, we collect the following categories of personal data:

• Identity data: Full name
• Contact data: Email address
• Account data: Workspace name, user role, job title
• Usage data: Login timestamps, in-platform actions, feature usage logs
• Content data: Customer interaction notes, tickets and related business data entered into the platform

Customer data you enter into talkinbio is processed on your behalf. In this context, your company also acts as a data controller for that data.

sections.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
sections.body:
We process your personal data under the following legal bases under GDPR Article 6:

• Account creation and authentication → Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b))
• Providing platform services → Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b))
• Security and audit logs → Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
• Product development and error analysis → Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
• Legal compliance → Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c))
• Marketing communications → Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) — only where you have given explicit consent

sections.title: 4. Data Transfers
sections.body: Your personal data may be transferred to Google Firebase and Supabase (acting as a data processor) to provide our technical infrastructure. Where data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with GDPR Chapter V, including Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active and for a defined period thereafter to meet legal obligations. Data that is no longer required is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights Under GDPR
sections.body:
Under GDPR, you have the following rights:

• Right of access — to obtain a copy of your personal data
• Right to rectification — to correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') — to request deletion of your data
• Right to restriction of processing
• Right to data portability
• Right to object — including to processing based on legitimate interests
• Rights related to automated decision-making and profiling

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@talkinbio.com. We will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
sections.body: The talkinbio platform uses strictly necessary cookies for session management and security. Analytics and marketing cookies are only used where you have given explicit consent. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: PEH reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy. Significant changes will be communicated to your registered email address. The current version is always available on this page.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: For all privacy-related requests and GDPR inquiries, please contact us at: info@talkinbio.com
